# FoodKart workspace notes

- Project: frontend-only food delivery demo named FoodKart.
- Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, CSS; no backend or payment processing.
- App content uses local sample restaurant data, emoji illustration, and React state.
- Keep interactions accessible with labels, keyboard focus styles, and responsive layouts.

## Project checklist

- [x] Requirements clarified from the request.
- [x] React + TypeScript + Vite scaffold created.
- [x] FoodKart UI and interactive frontend implemented.
- [x] No additional VS Code extensions needed.
- [x] Build and lint validation completed.
- [x] README and workspace instructions updated.
- [x] Project can be started with the documented Vite dev command.
